title: Timed mock: an unseen prompt

kcs.statement: Faced with an unseen prompt, the learner maps it within 5 minutes to known patterns (feed, chat, booking, media pipeline, location) and names which building blocks carry over.
In an unseen-prompt mock, the deep dive is spent on the part that no known pattern covers, for example inventory consistency in e-commerce, not on re-explaining standard components.
In an unseen-prompt mock, every major choice (store type, consistency level, sync vs async) is stated with one trade-off and the requirement that drove it.
In an unseen-prompt mock, the bottleneck review includes an availability figure in nines for the critical path, computed from component availabilities in series and parallel.

problem_ideas: Core activity: run 'design an e-commerce checkout' cold as one uninterrupted 45-minute attempt, submit the complete seven-area answer, then score it in a separate review.
Run 'design DoorDash' and name which parts reuse the ride hailing design.
Run 'design Spotify' and identify the media pipeline and the novel part.
Compute critical-path availability for LB → API → DB (99.99%, 99.9%, 99.95%) with 2 API replicas.
Variant: the interviewer changes the read/write ratio mid-interview. Adapt in 3 minutes.
Map five unfamiliar prompts to patterns in 60 seconds each.
